summary: Convert a Timeout to its same-thread numeric cancellation token.

target.notes: Return the Node timer token bound to the creating thread.

semantics.use: token can be passed to clearTimeout/clearInterval
semantics.thread_affinity: token is only valid on the thread where the Timeout was created

caveats: Do not treat the token as a process-global timer id across worker_threads.

tests.name: returns number usable for clear
tests.input: let fired=false; const t=setTimeout(()=>fired=true,5); const id=+t; clearTimeout(id); setTimeout(()=>console.log(typeof id,fired),10);

tests.name: preserves thread affinity contract
tests.expected_behavior: prints true; cross-worker use is not guaranteed valid
